planner.title: Bomb Farm Companion
planner.description: Import your Bomb Farm save and see what your next skill point is worth — every hero's geared stats, gear sets, points and DPS. Free, and the save never leaves your browser.
cardHeadline: is worth before you spend it.

farm.title: Farm — Bomb Farm Companion
farm.description: Every Bomb Farm phase ranked by what it pays your account per hour — gold, XP, item level, drop odds and clear time, worked out from your own save.

teamPlan.title: Team plan — Bomb Farm Companion
teamPlan.description: Plan gear moves, forge work and point resets across your whole Bomb Farm roster at once — scored for combined DPS, not one hero at a time.

inventory.title: Inventory — Bomb Farm Companion
inventory.description: Every item your Bomb Farm save carries, not only what is equipped — gear, gems, keys, House parts, skill stones and chests, with set, slot, level and forge.

account.title: Account — Bomb Farm Companion
account.description: Your Bomb Farm account at a glance — phase progress, House recovery cycle and slots, and every account-wide skill tree bonus totalled the way the game totals them.
cardHeadline: the way the game does it.

download.title: Download for Windows — Bomb Farm Companion
download.description: The free Windows companion for Bomb Farm: energy to full, when the next field clears, per-hero state, map value, and measured gold and XP rates. Open source, and it updates itself.
